architecture.frontend: Vanilla HTML5 + CSS3 + Vanilla ES6 JavaScript

storage.offline_voice: IndexedDB (Offline audio blobs, audio metadata, speech transcripts)
storage.cloud_database: Supabase PostgreSQL (Realtime sync, Row Level Security, User workspaces)

ai_nlp.local_engine: Regex Rule-Based Vietnamese Financial NLP Engine (0ms latency)
ai_nlp.speech_engine: Web Speech API vi-VN (Real-time Speech Recognition)
ai_nlp.cloud_ai: Google Gemini 2.5 Flash / 1.5 Flash REST API

file_structure.index.html: Single Page Application layout, modals system, header and navigation
file_structure.css/styles.css: Clean Light Mode styling, mobile-first media queries, animation rules
file_structure.js/app.js: State management, modal routing, event listeners, speech and audio recording
file_structure.js/data.js: AppData transaction models, categories, IndexedDB OfflineVoiceStorage
file_structure.js/utils.js: Currency formatters, date helpers, NLP sentence parser, Excel generator
file_structure.js/supabase-config.js: Supabase client wrapper and CRUD synchronization methods
